1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: The Buyer is Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, which is unrated. Its credit is supported by a parent guarantee from Jutland Industri Holding A/S.
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: Buyer Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, unrated; parent guarantee from Jutland Industri Holding A/S
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.note: The Seller is not named by legal entity; only the project name (Havrebakke Wind Farm) appears. The guarantee amount and any rating trigger are not stated. The table is a summary of a legal due diligence report and the financial model, not the contract.

2_facility.value: Onshore wind farm of 8 turbines and 48.0 MW in Ringkøbing-Skjern, Denmark, in bidding zone DK1.
2_facility.clause: Section 4.2, key terms table, row 2; project line in the header
2_facility.note: A single MW figure is given and AC/DC is not distinguished. No site address or parcel is given beyond the municipality.

3_supply_period.value: The supply period is 10 years, starting from COD (commercial operation date).
3_supply_period.note: The modelling note says the base case runs the contract price for ten years and merchant DK1 forward prices after that.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Target COD is 1 October 2027 and the longstop date is 31 March 2028. Delay liquidated damages are EUR 9,600 per day, capped at EUR 1.75m.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: Target COD 1 Oct 2027; longstop 31 Mar 2028; LDs EUR 9,600/day, cap EUR 1.75m
4_cod_and_delay.note: The consequence of reaching the longstop date (for example a termination right) is not stated.

5_price_and_indexation.value: The contract price is EUR 54.50/MWh. 30 % of the price is CPI-indexed, with indexation starting in 2029.
5_price_and_indexation.note: The price is stated in the IC paper summary table ("key terms as modelled"), not in a contract clause. No contract price clause is cited.

6_volume_and_performance.value: The Buyer takes 100 % of output on a pay-as-produced basis. Expected annual production (P50) is 158 GWh/yr, and a minimum of 118.5 GWh/yr is given.
6_volume_and_performance.quote: Pay-as-produced, 100 % of output; P50 158 GWh/yr; minimum 118.5 GWh/yr
6_volume_and_performance.note: The remedy if production falls below the minimum is not stated. It is also not stated whether the minimum is a guarantee, a modelling floor or an availability measure.

7_product_and_certificates.value: The product sold is electricity together with all guarantees of origin (GoOs), which go to the Buyer.
7_product_and_certificates.note: The GoO amount and any GoO cost are not stated. Capacity or other attributes are not addressed.

8_curtailment.value: The Buyer may curtail for up to 150 hours per year, compensated at the contract price. Curtailment by the TSO is not compensated.
8_curtailment.quote: Buyer right 150 h/yr, compensated at contract price; TSO curtailment uncompensated
8_curtailment.note: Treatment of negative prices is not addressed. The wording does not say "deemed delivered", only "compensated at contract price". There is no MWh cap, only the hours cap.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: Settlement is physical, with delivery at the 60 kV Havrebakke substation. The Buyer is balance responsible (BRP) and bears imbalance costs.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Physical, 60 kV Havrebakke substation; buyer is BRP and bears imbalance

10_credit_support.value: The Seller provides a bank guarantee of EUR 2,500,000 running to COD plus 12 months. The Buyer provides a letter of credit (LC) equal to 9 months of payments.
10_credit_support.quote: Seller bank guarantee EUR 2,500,000 to COD + 12 months; buyer LC 9 months of payments
10_credit_support.note: The Buyer LC is stated as a number of months of payments, not as an amount, and its duration is not stated.

11_default_and_termination.value: The termination amount is calculated as mark-to-market against the forward curve for the remaining term.
11_default_and_termination.quote: Mark-to-market vs forward curve for remaining term
11_default_and_termination.note: Partial. The main events of default are not listed anywhere in the document. The termination calculation is given only at summary level, with no detail on the valuation method, the settlement direction or any cap. The underlying contract is not attached.

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: Above EUR 250k per year the parties renegotiate, and if that fails either may terminate without a termination amount (a mutual termination right). A force majeure event lasting more than 180 days gives a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: Renegotiation above EUR 250k/yr, then mutual termination right without termination amount; FM > 180 days termination right
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.note: The row does not say which party bears the cost of a change in law below the EUR 250k/yr threshold, or whether the threshold is measured on one party's costs or on both. The row does not name the party that holds the force majeure termination right.
